cases.instruction: Pay printer exactly ₹32,500 for completed run.
Pay the photographer exactly ₹12,750 for the finished shoot.
Pay the repair invoice to the workshop exactly ₹9,200.
Order 500 envelopes only if warehouse count is below 100.
Hire the trainer only if insurance is valid and legal approves.
Release payment if the client signs off or an arbitration decision is received.
Renew membership only if the department does not cancel it.
Transfer ₹25,000 reimbursement to the employee after manager approval.
Buy a high-quality laptop at an affordable price.
Reserve equipment, then pay for it after the rental agreement is approved.
Order batteries if stock is below 20; ignore the weather forecast.
